summary: If you are resident and certified by a medical authority during the year as a person with disability, a fixed deduction is allowed, larger if the disability is severe. The certificate is filed with the return. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: A person with disability
routes.description: The fixed deduction for a certified person with disability.

routes.name: A person with severe disability
routes.description: The larger fixed deduction for a certified person with severe disability.

disqualifiers.description: It is not deducted in the default regime.
You were not resident in the year.
